en.headline: Segun Okafor faces chaos
en.body: Segun Okafor had picked a bold option moments earlier and now meets a chaotic final third (chaos 89). He must find a precise pass or risk a turnover as the game explodes.

ja.headline: Segun Okafor が混沌と対峙
